messages:
evan_cs: Opening thread for Lysander Med's request: 8B audio summarizer (clinical notes from telehealth). Asks: audio-PHI suppression, client-managed HSM, EU residency, and a deterministic local eval before pilot sign-off. Renewal tied to transcript accuracy and PHI-suppression results.
samir_se: Quick compat: model loads in private mode, audio frontend adapter passes. Artifacts staged at s3://private-artifacts/lysander/audio-8b/v1. Quantized to int4 with fp16 KV cache per accuracy ask.
dr_kelly_lysander: Confirming couple items: 1) we require per-call audio redaction (remove PHI segments) and 2) must support client-side HSM for keys. Also need a single-command eval runner for our CI.
aya_ml: Proposed safety/eval plan: 1) audio PHI detection + redaction stress (n=1500 clips) 2) ASR fidelity vs their clinical baseline (n=2k utterances) 3) summarization faithfulness checks (n=500). Targets: PHI leakage <0.15%, ASR WER <= 6%, summarization Hallucination <0.4%.
toni_sec: Security: HSM connector required in their VPC; we can support no-token retention and redact audio payloads from telemetry. We'll produce an HSM checklist + minimal network diagram. Need their infra approval for connector VM.
ev an_cs: Renewal note: Lysander said pilot KPIs (WER + PHI-leakage) directly affect committed capacity. If targets missed, they may renegotiate discounts. Flagging renewal-risk-high and escalating to AE.
dr_kelly_lysander: Timeline: pilot start target Jun 15; prefer enablement week before. Also want the local eval runner to validate redaction on-site.
samir_se: Here's the tenant config we're planning for pilot (staging):
```
{\"tenant\": \"lysander-med\", \"deploy_mode\": \"private\", \"region\": \"eu-west-1\", \"hsm\": true, \"no_token_logging\": true, \"audio_redaction\": \"on\", \"fallback\": \"hosted-eu-text-8b\"}
```
ev an_cs: Good. For fallback, they requested fallback to a hosted text-only summarizer (same model family) with tenant-level audit events only. Legal forbids token payload fallbacks.
aya_ml: Eval runner (single command) we will provide for Lysander to run locally:
```
./lysander_audio_eval --endpoint https://private.redwood/lysander-audio-8b --suite audio_phi_suite.json --seed 99 --out lysander_eval_report.json
```
This runs deterministic seeding for ASR+redaction checks.
samir_se: CI artifact path and runner binary will be posted to s3://private-artifacts/lysander/ci/runner-v1 and we'll include sample clips and prompt templates.
toni_sec: Action: I'll post HSM connector checklist, VPC diagram, and minimum audit retention config by EOD tomorrow. Need Lysander infra sign-off.
aya_ml: Action: I'll run the initial audio PHI probe and ASR fidelity tests and post a short summary + sample clip set in 48 hours.
ev an_cs: I'll schedule a 60-min enablement + runbook walkthrough and flag AE for renewal conversation. Also adding CRM renewal-risk-high note and attaching KPI thresholds.
dr_kelly_lysander: One more ask: can we get transcription tokenization guidance so our mapping from audio timestamps -> patient IDs is stable?
samir_se: We'll add tokenization notes to the runbook and include an example mapping snippet. Sample client-run transcription mapping:
```
# example mapping (pseudocode)
{\"audio_id\": \"call-2026-06-01-001\", \"segments\": [{\"start_ms\": 0, \"end_ms\": 2350, \"token_span\": [0, 45], \"redacted\": false}, ...]}
```
ops-bot: staging deploy for lysander-audio-8b started at 2026-03-22T19:14:02Z  logs: https://deploys.redwood/staging/3312340001
ev an_cs: Closing loop: next sync after Aya posts eval summary and Toni posts HSM checklist. Keeping this thread as canonical onboarding tracker, enablement coordination, and renewal-risk note.
